description: ADO-BATCH-SCOPE Update Criteria: for each value 0, 1, 2 and 3 of the Recordset property "Update Criteria" (set after Open on a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID, read back), a second Connection of the process changes V2 of row k (k = value + 1), then S of row k is set in the Recordset and UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) is called; read the Errors (cleared), the row's Status and S, then Close. Finally the stored rows through Execute. Asks whether a change to another column conflicts under each criteria value.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
